body.statement: If \(X_n\) converges in distribution to \(X\) and \(Y_n\) converges in probability to a constant \(c\), then sums and products converge to the corresponding sum and product; if \(c\neq0\), then \(X_n/Y_n\) converges in distribution to \(X/c\).

source.verbatim_statement: Let X_n, X, and Y_n be random vectors or variables. If X_n converges in distribution to X and Y_n converges in probability to a constant c, then X_n+Y_n converges in distribution to X+c, Y_n X_n converges in distribution to cX, and 1/Y_n converges in probability to 1/c if c is nonzero.

attestation.note: Transcribed from van der Vaart, Asymptotic Statistics (Cambridge University Press, 1998), Lemma 2.8; publisher source consulted.
